text:
aisha_parker: Quick sync — mapping private-offer renewal anchors with HW partner SKUs for Q3 launch. Need decision on min commit length and auto-renew fallback.

tom_lin: Re: commit length — sales wants 12mo minimum, finance is pushing for 6mo to reduce churn risk.

priya_shah: 6mo + automatic renewal opt-in seems safer. We can tier discounts: 6mo=5%, 12mo=12%, 24mo=18%.

marco_gonzalez: Agree. Also we need to align on 'unused credit roll-forward' policy for private offers. Partners asked for 30-day grace.

aisha_parker: Noted. Can we include a clause: unused committed spend rolls forward up to 30 days, after which consumption converts to pay-as-you-go at list price? draft snippet:
```
"commit_roll_forward": {
  "window_days": 30,
  "post_window_pricing": "payg_list"
}
```

tom_lin: That snippet looks good. Add an exception for BYO-hardware SKUs — partner wants permanent roll-forward for first year.

priya_shah: We should gate that with an activation threshold: BYO-HW roll-forward only if >$50k ARR and active usage >60% in month 11.

marco_gonzalez: +1. Also, for renewals send a soft notice 90 days prior, firm notice 30 days prior, and auto-renew fallback to the next-lower discount tier if no response.

aisha_parker: Timeline: finalize terms by Wed, legal to review Thu, partner sign-off by next Tue. Who owns sign-off with partner ops?

tom_lin: I'll take partner ops sign-off. @deploy-bot can you create a private-offer template with these params?

deploy-bot: created private_offer_template/1729999999 in the docs repo: https://redwood.internal/docs/private_offers#1729999999 :white_check_mark:

priya_shah: I'll draft the partner-facing language and share a one-pager.

aisha_parker: Perfect. Thanks team. Follow-ups: tom to own partner ops sign-off; priya to draft comms; marco to confirm the BYO threshold with hardware partner.

marco_gonzalez: Will sync with HW PM today and report back by EOD.

tom_lin: noted. :thumbsup:
